# Glens Falls Septic

> Septic system service company serving Glens Falls, Queensbury, and Lake George, NY. Services: septic tank pumping, septic system repair, new septic system installation, and septic inspections. Phone: (518) 659-1094. Prices are published on the website. Calls are taken evenings and weekends. Operated by Adirondack Leads.

## Services
- Septic tank pumping: typical cost $350-$600 depending on tank size and access
- Septic system repair: drain field repair, line replacement, baffle and filter service
- New septic system installation: typical cost $9,000-$28,000+ depending on soil, system type, and permits
- Septic inspections: for home sales and routine maintenance

## Service area
Glens Falls, Queensbury, South Glens Falls, Lake George, Hudson Falls, Warrensburg, Bolton Landing, Fort Edward, Kingsbury, Moreau, Lake Luzerne, Fort Ann (Warren, Washington, and northern Saratoga counties, NY)

## FAQ
- How often should a septic tank be pumped? Every 3-5 years for a typical household.
- What are signs a septic system needs service? Slow drains, sewage odors, wet or lush spots over the drain field, and backups.
- Do you offer free quotes? Yes, free quotes by phone at (518) 659-1094.
-  It's Saturday and my septic is backing up — can I actually reach someone? Yes. Call (518) 659-1094 — the line takes calls evenings and weekends, and urgent problems get a straight answer about timing on that same call.
